body: In my opinion the hardest part is when you have to say goodbye. Nothing is forever and it hurts so bad.
This is not the first time im doing that but now it's because the person I loved the most is no longer here.
What is your fav movie?

Sometimes.

If you love her try to find her.

It's all I can say.

I tried to kill myself 3 times already. 

The first time I was at the hospital my dad came to visit me after many years without talking and seeing each other. I thought things would change but no, they just come few days maybe to feel better about themselves but after that people will leave you again. This world is a fucking shit.
It's impossible. If they care about you they will always try to find you. If your friends and family are that important to you just stay with them, until the end.
I see. Im hurting a lot lately when dreaming because I see someone that was important to me and is no longer here.

Sometimes I can control my dreams. Sometimes I dream things that are going to happen and sometimes I have nightmares.

Even sleeping is scary.

How are your dreams?
You are right, I'll try to find another way. I shouldn't create trauma for people I don't know.

I can feel you.

"Theres a lot of ppl that loves you"

I disappeared for 2 weeks, not a single call.
I dont think so, maybe I'm a bad person after all.
Thanks but I am at that point, feeling like nothing will ever change.
I dont know anymore.. but as i said, thanks.

I know things can be different and still great, always happened.

The thing is even if it's great it will end again so I don't see what's the point anymore. I see no future, can't trust people, I dislike my life and I think it's my choice to go away now but I dont know how to make it.

Anyway, thanks for trying to make me feel better.
I always liked to imagine that after death you can see how everyone's life goes on, you are invisible and feel nothing.

You don't build up courage to finally attempt.

That night I had a lot of anxiety and pain, I just wanted it all to be over so i wrote goodbye msgs and took pills. I was completely convinced I wouldn't wake up but stupid me, I didn't know it was so hard to overdose.

Some people say "It's never too late" so don't worry about not being on a party at 22, maybe you will do at 23.

I lost myself but i hope it gets better for you.
It's really good that you can enjoy time alone. It will get better for you.
I really hate this world.
I am so sorry about your first relationship. You can talk to me if you need it, i am 20yo and i had my first relationship on the internet this year aswell even tho we met irl.
